title: fix: stabilize generation and desktop UX
body:
## Summary

Closes the systemic desktop generation and UX gaps from the approved AIP mission while preserving Rust/SQLite authority, local-first privacy, temporary-chat isolation, and existing Phase 7-13 boundaries.

## Implementation

- Phase A: bounded generation context and queue/terminal behavior; the real Rust -> managed Python sidecar -> local Ollama -> stream -> persistence path is exercised by the ignored desktop-equivalent integration test.
- Phase B: additive conversation empty-expiry migration, startup/list cleanup, first-message TTL clearing, local draft lifecycle, explicit named-empty save, deterministic active/list refresh, AIP confirmation dialog, and hidden pending-assistant actions.
- Phase C: shared accessible custom model picker with search/listbox keyboard behavior, availability/loading/error states, and bounded scroll policy across workspace surfaces.
- Phase D: replay-safe optional human identity migration, bounded custom pronouns, owner-scoped human-only fields, and explicit State/Memories/calendar semantics without health telemetry claims.
- Phase E: transparent native overlay sizing/positioning, bounded bubble layout, internal scrolling, and composer guards for queued generation/cancel/retry behavior.
- Documentation and contracts now describe the shipped lifecycle, identity, model availability, and State boundaries without promising future effects.

## Evidence

- Final branch HEAD: `3ac35a2b190d8472efb918d2fae8fe2f27d118f7`; parent `main`: `c8dcbcd128e4f2babc2d4ebe27259f28529cef81`.
- Frontend/contracts: `pnpm test` passed 24 files / 89 desktop tests plus 23 contract tests; workspace typecheck, lint, build, secrets scan, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Rust/Tauri: `pnpm tauri:check` passed fmt, locked check, clippy `-D warnings`, and 163 tests (1 optional Ollama test ignored); the fresh real Ollama end-to-end test passed separately.
- Python/runtime: `pnpm python:check` passed formatting, lint, mypy, and 27 unittest cases; packaged runtime build and sidecar smoke passed.
- Branch package build passed on this exact HEAD: MSI SHA-256 `11CB26EB185FB8450AA7813EE566A142922CED32AB3642C2DA30E8188526014B`; NSIS SHA-256 `F8DB182B6278733C9C30CD4A4F5E19BD2E54D5AA07E11A97FA6FE0906CCABCBD`. Both are unsigned local artifacts; post-merge CI artifacts remain authoritative.
- Targeted security review found no raw HTML injection/eval/shell/filesystem writes/telemetry path in the diff; Rust remains authoritative and temporary-chat/owner gates remain fail-closed.

## Validation boundaries

The installed-Windows visual smoke (transparent overlay pass-through, popup sizing, scroll/focus transitions, restart persistence, and the Portuguese acceptance checklist) remains a human gate and is not claimed by CI. Local Android Gradle validation is unavailable on this host because `JAVA_HOME`/Java is absent; the required Android workflow must run remotely. `pnpm format:check` remains a pre-existing broad baseline divergence outside this focused diff and is not a CI job.

This is a functional Draft PR, not release/tag/deploy authorization. Merge is contingent on protected remote CI (Android, phase-zero, and package) and normal repository review; no signing or stable release is requested.
